data.body: RED (AC2): before the `src/` edit, `pytest tests/unit/test_snapshot_build_dir_length.py` gave 2 failed and 3 passed. `test_git_writes_a_ticket_snapshot_into_a_short_flat_build` failed because the build was `.../tmp/tickets-<12>-<32>/.tickets-tracker`, which does not match `t-[0-9a-f]{8}`. `test_git_writes_a_code_snapshot_into_a_short_build` failed on the name `build-f47c9acfb27b-1038ce82a5834e12b8bf3bb5efc613be`. The budget, failure-path and lost-race tests passed on the old code too, as expected, because they pin behavior that must be preserved. After the fix: 5 passed, and tests/unit/test_repo_snapshot.py plus tests/interfaces/store/test_gate_ticket_snapshot.py pass (30 total). Deselect list: removed the 203 snapshot lines and kept the 13 test_autodeploy_prune.py lines, because Gerrit 3428 (requires_posix_shell) has not merged.
